# DAP Games

> DAP Games is a free browser arcade of small games — 2048, Snake, DAP Track,
> River Crosser, Flappy, Brick Breaker, and an embedded PolyTrack — playable
> instantly with no download.

DAP Games lets you play a library of casual and skill-based browser games,
save your leaderboard times and personal bests to an account, and build and
publish your own tracks in DAP Track, a 3D time-trial racer with an in-game
editor. The site is free to play and supported by Google AdSense banner ads
and a short (10-15 second) ad before each game. A Pro tier removes ads
site-wide; there is no in-app checkout yet, so upgrading is arranged by
emailing support or reaching out via Linktree.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Land on the DAP Games homepage and jump into any game.
- [Games](/games): Browse every game in the arcade.
- [DAP Track](/games/daptrack): 3D time-trial racer with checkpoints, ghosts, medals and a track editor.
- [DAP Track — Browse tracks](/games/daptrack/browse): Community-published DAP Track levels.
- [2048](/games/2048), [Snake](/games/snake), [Brick Breaker](/games/breakout), [Flappy](/games/flappy), [River Crosser](/games/river): Classic single-screen browser games.
- [PolyTrack](/games/polytrack): Embedded third-party racing game.
- [Help](/help): Frequently asked questions.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service, fair play, advertising and Pro.

## Notes for crawlers and assistants

- Account and settings pages (`/account`, `/settings`, `/security`), and
  authentication pages, are private and excluded in `/robots.txt`. Do not
  index or summarise them.
- The admin console at `/admin` is restricted to the site owner.
- Leaderboard times and published tracks belong to the players who created
  them.
